commentary.bulkers: The Capesize "Lake Dolphin" 179/2011 Hanjin, Korea (SS/DD 06/2026) was committed to Chinese interests at low USD 30 mill. For comparison, the sister vessel "Mineral Subic" 179/2011 Hanjin, Korea (SS/DD 05/2026) was sold in October at USD 30,25 mill. The Post Panamax "Peace Ark" 93/2010 Jiangsu, China (SS 09/2030, DD 09/2028) was committed to Chinese interests at USD 13 mill. Remind you that the two-years-younger sister vessel "Declan Duff" 93/2012 Jiangsu, China (SS/DD 07/2027) was sold back in October at USD 13,6 mill. Nippo Shipping have committed their Kamsarmax "Key Frontier" 80/2011 Universal, Japan (SS 06/2030, DD 05/2028) to Greek interests at high USD 18 mill. Note that a month ago, the one-year-younger "New Ascent" 82/2012 Tsuneishi, Japan (SS/DD 08/2027) was sold at high USD 19 mill. The Panamax "The Strong" 74/2004 Hudong-Zhonghua, China (SS 08/2027, DD 06/2026) of SNP Shipping Services was committed to Chinese interests at USD 6,85 mill, while the one-year-younger sister vessel "Catalina" 74/2005 Hudong-Zhonghua, China (SS 04/2028, DD 04/2026, Scrubber fitted) from TMS Bulkers was committed at USD 7,9 mill. Remind you that the sister vessel "Majorca" 74/2005 Hudong-Zhonghua, China (SS 11/2027, DD 12/2025, Scrubber fitted) was sold in October at USD 7,5 mill. On the Supramax sector, Jinhui Shipping & Transportation committed their "Jin Bi" 56/2012 Jiangsu, China (SS/DD 09/2027) to clients of Xing Le Investments at USD 14,4 mill. For comparison, the one-year-older sister vessel "Aggeliki B" 56/2011 Jiangsu, China (SS/DD 05/2026) was sold a month ago at USD 13,4 mill. Mariners Shipping Agency have committed the Handysize "Sofia K" 32/2009 Hakodate, Japan (SS/DD 05/2027) at USD 11 mill. Note that a couple of weeks ago, the one-year-younger sister vessel "Kallisti GS" 32/2010 Hakodate, Japan (SS 02/2030, DD 12/2027) was sold at low USD 11 mill.
commentary.tankers: The Aframax "Ark" 105/2008 Tsuneishi, Japan (SS 01/2028, DD 05/2026) from IMS was committed to Turkish interests at USD 27 mill. Remind you that back in September, the one-year-older "Patmos Warrior" 105/2007 Sumitomo, Japan (SS 10/2027, DD 02/2026) was sold at USD 28 mill. The MR2 "LVM Warrior" 50/2015 Hyundai Mipo, Korea (SS 01/2030, DD 03/2028, Scrubber fitted) was committed at USD 33,3 mill. Note that the one-year-older sister vessels "STI Battery", "STI Milwaukee", "STI Venere" & "STI Yorkville" were sold in November at USD 32 mill each. In addition, the "Minerva Lydia" 48/2004 Iwagi, Japan (SS 05/2029, DD 06/2027) was committed to Chinese interests at USD 10,4 mill. For reference, the two- years-younger "Kyra" 47/2006 Iwagi, Japan (SS/DD 01/2026) was committed a week ago at USD 11,35 mil but eventually failed.

freight.Capesize: at the level of low usd 12,00's fio range. No period activity to report here.
freight.Kamsarmax / Panamax: North Pacific rounds ranged at the usd 20,000/22,000 pd. A number of Indonesian and Australian trips into China were reported fixed in the usd 17,000/20,000 pd range. Indonesian trips into India were fixed around usd 16,000/18,000 pd. Indian trips via South America into China were reported at the level of usd 16,000/18,000 pd. Continental trips via US East Coast into India were fixed around usd 26,000/27,000 pd. Inter-Continental trips via East Coast Canada were reported at the level of usd 17,000/19,000 pd. East Coast South American trips into Continent were fixed around usd 28,000/29,000 pd. East Coast South American trips into China were reported at the level of usd 16,000/18,000 pd plus ballast bonus at the usd 600K/800K. On the period front, a Kamsarmax was reported fixed in the usd 20,000 pd for min 110 days employment basis delivery Arabian Gulf.
freight.Ultramax / Supramax: A generally quiet week for this segment. Trips from North China into Mediterranean were reported at the level of usd 13,000/14,000 pd. West Coast Indian trips into China were fixed around usd 15,000/17,000 pd. West Coast Indian trips via South Africa into East Coast India were reported at the level of usd 15,000/16,000 pd. Arabian Gulf trips into West Coast India were fixed around usd 18,000/20,000 pd. East Coast South American trips into West Coast India were reported at the level of usd 15,000/17,000 pd plus ballast bonus at the usd 500K/700K. No period activity to report here.
freight.Handymax / Handysize: Trips from South China into South East Asia were fixed around usd 10,000/12,000 pd. Australian trips into China were reported at the level of usd 15,000/17,000 pd. West Coast Indian trips via Arabian Gulf into China were fixed around usd 8,000/9,000 pd. South African trips via US East Coast into West Africa were reported at the level of usd 22,000/24,000 pd. Mediterranean trips into US East Coast-US Gulf were fixed around usd 12,000/15,000 pd. South American coastal trips were reported at the level of usd 16,000/17,000 pd. South American trips into US Gulf were fixed around usd 14,000/16,000 pd. South American trips into West Africa were reported at the level of usd 19,000/20,000 pd. On the period front, a large Handysize was reported fixed in the usd 15,500 pd for 5/6 months employment basis delivery Continent with redelivery Singapore/Japan range.
